title: appealing an infraction

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

You were banned for Excessive Infractions which means that you had to many infractions. It is usually very hard to appeal this type of punishment. Secondly, you were ban evading shortly after your ban. You will not be appealed.

Regards,
Pelpelajax, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
